Name: DE-RateCardsColumns
Statement:
select  rtc.Oid as RateCardId,
        rtc.Name as RateCard,
        rcc.Oid as RateCardColumnId,
        rcc.Name as RateCardColumn,
        rci.Oid as RateCardItemId,
        riv.Oid as RateCardItemValueId,
        rtc.Active,
        rtc.BeginDate as StartDate,
        rtc.EndDate as EndDate,
        cur.Oid as CurrencyId,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        dep.Oid as RateCardItemDepartmentId,
        dep.Name as RateCardItemDepartment,
        utg.Oid as RateCardItemTypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as RateCardItemTypologyGroup,
        usr.Oid as RateCardItemUserId,
        usr.Name as RateCardItemUser,
        riv.Cost
from    RateCard rtc
            join RateCardItem rci on rci.RateCard = rtc.Oid
            join RateCardItemValue riv on riv.RateCardItem = rci.Oid
            join RateCardColumn rcc on rcc.Oid = riv.RateCardColumn
            join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = rci.UserTypologyGroup
            left join [User] usr on usr.Oid = rci.[User]
            left join Department dep on dep.Oid = rci.Department
            left join Company com on com.Oid = rtc.Company
            left join Currency cur on cur.Oid = rtc.Currency
